value_flows.description: Farm creation: User sends farm_asset tokens (e.g., uusdy) and create_farm_fee (e.g., uom) to contract. Fee goes to fee_collector, farm_asset is stored for reward distribution.
value_flows.order: 1. Validate LP denom via pool_manager. 2. Check/create LP weight snapshot via epoch_manager. 3. Transfer create_farm_fee to fee_collector. 4. Transfer farm_asset from user to contract. 5. Store Farm and Position metadata.

value_flows.description: Position creation: User sends LP tokens to contract, which locks them as a position for a farm. No immediate token transfer, just ownership tracking.
value_flows.order: 1. Validate LP denom and unlocking_duration. 2. Create Position metadata with owner=sender. 3. Update farm's total_lp_weight if active.

value_flows.description: Claim rewards: User receives farm_asset tokens proportional to their position's lp_weight and the farm's remaining (unclaimed) farm_asset amount.
value_flows.order: 1. Calculate user's share = (position.lp_weight / farm.total_lp_weight) * (farm.farm_asset.amount - farm.claimed_amount). 2. Transfer share to user. 3. Update farm.claimed_amount and position.claimed_amount.

value_flows.description: Farm closure: Owner can close farm early, returning unclaimed farm_asset tokens to them (minus any penalty).
value_flows.order: 1. Verify caller is farm creator. 2. Calculate penalty if farm is closed before start_epoch. 3. Transfer remaining farm_asset (minus penalty) to creator. 4. Mark farm as closed.

value_flows.description: Emergency unlock: Position owner can unlock early, paying a penalty in farm_asset which is distributed to other position holders.
value_flows.order: 1. Verify caller is position owner and position is not yet unlocked. 2. Calculate penalty = emergency_unlock_penalty * (position.lp_weight / farm.total_lp_weight) * farm.farm_asset.amount. 3. Deduct penalty from user's claimable rewards and add to other positions.

value_flows.order: 1. Check position expiration 2. Calculate penalty if emergency_unlock 3. Transfer LP tokens to user (minus penalty if applicable) 4. Update Position state

value_flows.description: Pool creation fee collected when CreatePool is executed
Liquidity provision transfers user tokens to pool, mints LP tokens to user/farm
Liquidity withdrawal burns LP tokens, returns underlying assets to user
Swap transfers input tokens from user, calculates output with fees, sends output tokens
ExecuteSwapOperations chains multiple swaps, final output goes to user/receiver
Fee collection transfers swap fees to fee_collector_addr

execute ManageFarm Fill: execute -> manage_farm -> handle_farm_fill -> validate_farm_params -> validate_lp_denom (pool_manager query) -> create_lp_weight_snapshot (epoch_manager query) -> transfer_tokens (create_farm_fee to fee_collector) -> transfer_tokens (farm_asset from user) -> save_farm -> update_farm_in_map
execute ManageFarm Close: execute -> manage_farm -> handle_farm_close -> validate_ownership -> calculate_penalty -> transfer_tokens (remaining farm_asset to creator) -> mark_farm_closed
execute ManagePosition Create: execute -> manage_position -> handle_position_create -> validate_unlocking_duration -> transfer_tokens (LP from user) -> save_position -> update_farm_lp_weight
execute Claim: execute -> handle_claim -> get_position -> get_farm -> calculate_claimable -> transfer_tokens (rewards to user) -> update_claimed_amounts
